watches.name: Van Speyk Spirit SSZ-BL
watches.description: The Spirit SSZ-BL watch features a Swiss automatic STP1-11 movement with Cotes de Geneve. The watch has a beautiful view of the movement due to the “open heart” in the dial. The stainless steel watch case has a diameter of 41mm and features a glass back with a view of the movement. With a “sunray” dial, engraved crown and rotor of the movement, much attention has been given to the details of the watch. The blue watch strap is handmade in Italy from the finest leather and features a handy folding clasp. This Spirit SSZ-BL watch comes with a beautiful leather case, certificate with serial number and comes with a 3-year international warranty. Movement Automatic, Swiss made – STP1-11 with Cotes de Geneve 28’800 vibrations per hour (4Hz) 26 jewels Nivaflex NM spring Incabloc shockabsorber Gilt balance wheel Case Polished stainless steel with lugs finished in matt. Dial Silver sunray dial. Band Blue, handmade Italian leather. Quick release system and folding clasp. Glass Sapphire glass front, sapphire glass back with view of movement. Features Hours, minutes, seconds and open heart. Finish Van Speyk monogram on crown, rotor and folding clasp. Cross section 41mm without crown (44mm including crown). Height 14 mm Weight 90 gram Warranty 3 years Each Van Speyk Spirit watch is individually numbered Delivered in a watch box including manual and certificate.
